title: How BestChatBot Books Calls at 1am While You Sleep #shortsfeed
description:
It's 1am, a lead lands on your site, and BestChatBot books the call for Thursday while you sleep. 

It pulls your real Cal.com slots for the next seven days, the visitor picks a time and drops a name and email, no sign-in, and the booking is done.

See the AI booking bot cover you 24/7 and try it free at https://bestchatbot.io #aichatbot #aibooking #calcom #calendly #appointmentbooking
